meta.name: DDD token export
meta.about: The DDD design system as W3C Design Tokens Community Group JSON, generated from elements/d-d-d/tokens: 820 tokens in 29 groups, 256 dark-mode overrides, 10 types. In step with the element source: build-tokens.js --check passes.

dtcg.desc: DDD and SimpleColors as W3C DTCG design tokens, generated from the element source so design tools see exactly what the elements use: 820 tokens (312 of them aliases of another token), 256 dark-mode overrides, 2 themes. In step with the element source: build-tokens.js --check passes.

f_metadata_json.desc: The set order for Tokens Studio's multi-file sync: ddd.tokens, ddd.dark.tokens.

f_themes_json.desc: The themes for Tokens Studio: Light (ddd.tokens), Dark (ddd.tokens, ddd.dark.tokens).

f_ddd_dark_tokens_json.desc: Only what changes in dark mode: 256 overrides. Apply it on top of ddd.tokens.json.

f_ddd_tokens_json.desc: Every token with its light value: 820 in 29 groups. Each carries its CSS custom property in $extensions so tools can map back to var(--ddd-*).

g_ddd_color.desc: 101 tokens, 26 aliases. Types: color 93, untyped 8. For example --ddd-theme-default-beaverBlue.

g_ddd_font.desc: 34 tokens, 7 aliases. Types: dimension 25, fontWeight 5, fontFamily 4. For example --ddd-font-primary.

g_ddd_border.desc: 8 tokens. Types: border 4, dimension 4. For example --ddd-border-xs.

g_ddd_headerborder.desc: 16 tokens, 2 aliases. Types: dimension 11, untyped 5. For example --ddd-theme-header-border-thickness-0.

g_ddd_dropzone.desc: 6 tokens, 3 aliases. Types: dimension 3, color 2, untyped 1. For example --ddd-drop-zone-outline-color.

g_ddd_shadow.desc: 5 tokens, 4 change in dark mode. Types: shadow 5. For example --ddd-boxShadow-0.

g_ddd_layout.desc: 19 tokens, 8 aliases. Types: dimension 15, untyped 4. For example --ddd-content-width-sm.

g_ddd_radius.desc: 8 tokens. Types: dimension 7, untyped 1. For example --ddd-radius-0.

g_ddd_easing.desc: 5 tokens. Types: cubicBezier 4, untyped 1. For example --ddd-timing-ease.

g_ddd_focus.desc: 2 tokens. Types: border 1, dimension 1. For example --ddd-focus-ring.

g_ddd_mediacontrol.desc: 8 tokens, 6 aliases. Types: color 3, dimension 2, border 2, untyped 1. For example --ddd-media-control-size.

g_ddd_eyebrow.desc: 9 tokens, 7 aliases, 1 change in dark mode. Types: untyped 4, dimension 2, color 2, fontWeight 1. For example --ddd-eyebrow-font-family.

g_ddd_skeleton.desc: 5 tokens, 3 aliases, 2 change in dark mode. Types: color 2, dimension 2, duration 1. For example --ddd-skeleton-base.

g_ddd_status.desc: 29 tokens, 22 aliases, 21 change in dark mode. Types: color 22, untyped 7. For example --ddd-status-default-signal.

g_simple_colors_default.desc: 228 tokens, 228 aliases, 228 change in dark mode. Types: color 228. For example --simple-colors-default-theme-grey-1.

ty_untyped.desc: 35 tokens carry no $type of their own or from their group.

t_build.desc: Exports DDD and SimpleColors as DTCG from the element source; --check fails CI when the committed files are stale. Last check here: checked 4 files in elements/d-d-d/tokens: 820 tokens, 256 dark overrides; not exported (RGB channel triplets and component defaults): 35.

s_dddstyles_js.desc: Element source the export reads: elements/d-d-d/lib/DDDStyles.js.

s_dddstatustokens_js.desc: Element source the export reads: elements/d-d-d/lib/DDDStatusTokens.js.

s_simple_colors_js.desc: Element source the export reads: elements/simple-colors/simple-colors.js.

s_dddlayout_js.desc: Element source the export reads: elements/d-d-d/lib/DDDLayout.js.

ci_0.desc: A step of the ddd-token-lint workflow, which fails a webcomponents pull request: node scripts/ddd-token-lint.js

ci_1.desc: A step of the ddd-token-lint workflow, which fails a webcomponents pull request: node elements/d-d-d/design-system/build-tokens.js --check

r_figma_via_tokens_studio.desc: Named in the tokens README as a tool that reads DTCG: Figma via Tokens Studio.

r_style_dictionary.desc: Named in the tokens README as a tool that reads DTCG: Style Dictionary.

r_penpot.desc: Named in the tokens README as a tool that reads DTCG: Penpot.

tours.label: DDD as design tokens
tours.message: 820 tokens in 29 groups, 256 dark-mode overrides, generated from the element source.

scenes.caption: DDD lives in the elements' CSS. The export turns it into DTCG JSON that design tools read.
The groups, named after the CSS custom properties.
SimpleColors comes along, fixed and default; the default palette flips in dark mode.
Every token has a DTCG type.
build-tokens.js reads the element source and writes the files; CI fails a pull request when they fall out of date.
